name: glass-carousel
title: Glass Carousel
description: A full-screen carousel seen through liquid glass: as you swipe, the cards bend inward at the screen edges with a rainbow fringe while the settled card stays sharp. Cards shrink with speed and snap on a critically damped spring. Tap the centre card and it lifts while the others fall away in a stagger; tap again to bring them back. Backgrounds cross-fade with the scroll.
